notes.title: Game Upate of May 14, 2018
Game Upate of May 18, 2018:
Game Upate of May 14, 2018
notes.notes:
Thank you for supporting "Reignman". According to feedback from players, we updated the game today and fixed some bugs.

1. Fix the bug that windows 10 cannot open after installation. If you can't open the game, please uninstall and re-install it.
2. Fix the bug that cannot be displayed by the heros in Chapter 5.
3. Fix the bug that crash in the Chapter 4;

Thank you for your valuable comments, we will continue to optimize the game in future versions

Open 3 chapters levels。

This version is the Early Acces version, the degree of completion is 80%, So we hope you provide valuable suggestions, we will try our best to optimize the game version
